arxiv-2112-02029.title: The BeEST Experiment: Searching for Beyond Standard Model Neutrinos using 7 Be Decay in STJs Journal: Journal of Low Temperature Physics
arxiv-2112-02029.creator: K.G. Leach † and S. Friedrich ‡ for the BeEST Collaboration
arxiv-2112-02029.description: Abstract Precision measurements of nuclear β \beta decay are among the most sensitive methods to probe beyond Standard Model (BSM) physics in the neutrino sector. In particular, momentum conservation between the emitted decay products in the final state is sensitive to any massive new physics that couples to the neutrino mass.

Special thanks go my advisor D. Dolgopyat for suggesting this problem, and providing helpful comments throughout. Thanks also go to A. Kanigowski, fo

arxiv-2301-09736.description: Abstract 0 0 footnotetext: Key words ergodic theory, hyperbolic dynamical system, limit distribution, Poisson process, rare events Abstract We obtain a Poisson Limit for return times to small sets for product systems. Only one factor is required to be hyperbolic while the second factor is only required to satisfy polynomial deviation bounds for ergodic sums.

arxiv-2310-10538.title: Efficient Quantum Circuits based on the Quantum Natural Gradient
arxiv-2310-10538.creator: Ananda Roy, Sameer Erramilli, Robert M. Konik
arxiv-2310-10538.description: Abstract Efficient preparation of arbitrary entangled quantum states is crucial for quantum computation. This is particularly important for noisy intermediate scale quantum simulators relying on variational hybrid quantum-classical algorithms. To that end, we propose symmetry-conserving modified quantum approximate optimization algorithm (SCom-QAOA) circuits.

arxiv-2311-10373.title: FOAL: Fine-grained Contrastive Learning for Cross-domain Aspect Sentiment Triplet Extraction
arxiv-2311-10373.creator: Ting Xu, Zhen Wu, Huiyun Yang, Xinyu Dai
arxiv-2311-10373.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ting Xu, Zhen Wu, Huiyun Yang, Xinyu Dai. Aspect Sentiment Triplet Extraction (ASTE) has achieved promising results while relying on sufficient annotation data in a specific domain. However, it is infeasible to annotate data for each individual domain. We propose to explore ASTE in the cross-domain setting, which transfers knowledge from a resource-rich source domain to a resource-poor target domain, thereby alleviating the reliance on labeled data in the target domain.

arxiv-2312-01923.title: Clonal dynamics of surface-driven growing tissues
arxiv-2312-01923.creator: Ruslan I. Mukhamadiarov, Matteo Ciarchi, Fabrizio Olmeda, Steffen Rulands
arxiv-2312-01923.description: Abstract The self-organization of cells into complex tissues relies on a tight coordination of cell behavior. Identifying the cellular processes driving tissue growth is key to understanding the emergence of tissue forms and devising targeted therapies for aberrant growth, such as in cancer.

arxiv-2408-00399.title: Unsupervised Pairwise Causal Discovery on Heterogeneous Data using Mutual Information Measures
arxiv-2408-00399.creator: Alexandre Trilla, Nenad Mijatovic
arxiv-2408-00399.description: Abstract A fundamental task in science is to determine the underlying causal relations because it is the knowledge of this functional structure what leads to the correct interpretation of an effect given the apparent associations in the observed data. In this sense, Causal Discovery is a technique that tackles this challenge by analyzing the statistical properties of the constituent variables.

arxiv-2408-17346.title: On Nonparanormal Likelihoods
arxiv-2408-17346.creator: Torsten Hothorn Universität Zürich
arxiv-2408-17346.description: Abstract \Plainauthor Hothorn \Plaintitle On Nonparanormal Likelihoods \Shorttitle On Nonparanormal Likelihoods \Abstract Nonparanormal models describe the joint distribution of multivariate responses via latent Gaussian, and thus parametric, copulae while allowing flexible nonparametric marginals. Some aspects of such distributions, for example conditional independence, are formulated parametrically. Other features, such as marginal distributions, can be formulated non- or semiparametrically.

arxiv-2411-15328.title: Dependence Induced Representations
arxiv-2411-15328.creator: Xiangxiang Xu, Lizhong Zheng
arxiv-2411-15328.description: Abstract We study the problem of learning feature representations from a pair of random variables, where we focus on the representations that are induced by their dependence. We provide sufficient and necessary conditions for such dependence induced representations, and illustrate their connections to Hirschfeld–Gebelein–Rényi (HGR) maximal correlation functions and minimal sufficient statistics.

arxiv-2412-18333.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by A. M. Dmytrenko, P. N. Fedorov, V. S. Akhmetov, A. B. Velichko, S. I. Denyshchenko, V. P. Khramtsov, I. B. Vavilova, D. V. Dobrycheva, O. arxiv-2505-06652.title: Enfoque Odychess: Un método dialéctico, constructivista y adaptativo para la enseñanza del ajedrez con inteligencias artificiales generativas
arxiv-2505-06652.creator: Ernesto Giralt Hernandez https://orcid.org/0009-0005-6357-7522, Lazaro Antonio Bueno Perez https://orcid.org/0000-0002-5187-0968
arxiv-2505-06652.description: Abstract RESUMEN Introducción: La didáctica del ajedrez ha evolucionado a través de diferentes enfoques, sin embargo, las metodologías tradicionales, a menudo basadas en la memorización, contrastan significativamente con las nuevas posibilidades que ofrece la inteligencia artificial generativa, una tecnología aún poco explorada en este campo.

arxiv-2507-07028.title: On Construction of Approximate Real Mutually Unbiased Bases for an infinite class of dimensions d ≢ 0 mod 4 d\not\equiv 0\bmod 4
arxiv-2507-07028.creator: Ajeet Kumar, Rakesh Kumar, Subhamoy Maitra, Uddipto Mandal
arxiv-2507-07028.description: Abstract It is known that real Mutually Unbiased Bases (MUBs) do not exist for any dimension d > 2 d>2 which is not divisible by 4. Thus, the next combinatorial question is how one can construct Approximate Real MUBs (ARMUBs) in this direction with encouraging parameters.

arxiv-2508-17350.title: Comparison of FTN-NOFDM and PCS-OFDM for Long-Haul Coherent Optical Communications
arxiv-2508-17350.creator: Haide Wang, Ji Zhou, Yongcheng Li, Weiping Liu, Changyuan Yu, Xiangjun Xin, Liangchuan Li
arxiv-2508-17350.description: Abstract Single-wavelength 400G coherent optical communications have become a critical solution to meet the explosive traffic demands. However, the single-carrier modulation using low-order modulation formats requires a broader wavelength division multiplexing grid and expands the occupied optical bandwidth. In this paper, we propose the faster-than-Nyquist non-orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (FTN-NOFDM) to improve the spectral efficiency for long-haul coherent optical communications.

pmc-10675281.title: Carbohydrate Counting, Empowerment and Glycemic Outcomes in Adolescents and Young Adults with Long Duration of Type 1 Diabetes
pmc-10675281.creator: Elisabeth Jelleryd, Anna Lena Brorsson, Carmel E Smart, Ulrika Käck, Anna Lindholm Olinder, Claudia Vetrani
pmc-10675281.description: The complex treatment for diabetes type 1 (T1D) includes insulin dosing for every meal, which requires education and experience to achieve optimal outcomes. Advanced carbohydrate counting (ACC) is the recommended method. We studied ACC as part of a standard treatment with the aim to explore its associations with glycemic control and empowerment in adolescents and young adults.

pmc-11550253.title: Disulfidptosis-related long non-coding RNA signature predicts the prognosis, tumor microenvironment, immunotherapy, and antitumor drug options in colon adenocarcinoma
pmc-11550253.creator: Kang Wang, Jing Yu, Qihuan Xu, Yuanhong Peng, Haibin Li, Yan Lu, Manzhao Ouyang
pmc-11550253.description: This study aims to investigate the role and prognostic significance of long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) associated with disulfidptosis in colon adenocarcinoma (COAD). The TCGA database’s clinical data and transcriptome profiles were employed. Analysis of previous studies identified 10 disulfidptosis-related genes (DRGs).

pmc-12566567.title: Pro-Apoptotic and Cytotoxic Effects of Melittin on HL-60 Acute Promyelocytic Leukemia Cells: Implications for Retinoid-Independent Therapy
pmc-12566567.creator: Maksymilian Stela, Michał Ceremuga, Natalia Cichon, Tomasz Poplawski, Marcin Podogrocki, Leslaw Gorniak, Michał Bijak, Simona Sagona
pmc-12566567.description: Background: Acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL) is a subtype of acute myeloid leukemia driven by the PML/RARα fusion protein. Standard treatment with all-trans retinoic acid (ATRA) combined with chemotherapy is effective, but resistance and adverse effects remain significant challenges. Melittin, the primary peptide component of bee venom, has demonstrated potent anticancer activity across multiple leukemia subtypes through mitochondrial-dependent mechanisms.

pmc-12655678.title: Comparative Analysis of Classic and Novel Antitussives on Cough Suppression in Guinea Pigs
pmc-12655678.creator: Paula Montero, Inés Roger, Erika Esposito, Javier Milara, Julio Cortijo
pmc-12655678.description: Introduction: Cough is a common reflex that serves a protective role, but when persistent, it can severely affect patients’ quality of life. Despite its high prevalence, current treatment options remain limited. Traditional antitussives such as codeine and dextromethorphan present notable side effects, underscoring the need for safer and more effective alternatives.

pmc-13048859.title: Development and Validation of Novel Senescence-TIME Biomarkers for Predicting the Prognosis and Immunotherapy Responsiveness of SKCM Patients
pmc-13048859.creator: Shiying Fan, Shuya Lu, Zilong Wu, Xu Li, Yisong Gao, Gan Mao, Mao Cai, Tianyu Song, Zuojie Peng, Chong Li, Kaixiong Tao, Wei Li
pmc-13048859.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundIncreasing evidence indicates that tumor cellular senescence can impair antitumor immunity and promote skin cutaneous melanoma (SKCM) progression. However, effective methods for assessing tumor cellular senescent status and tumor immune microenvironment (TIME) status remain lacking.

pmc-13068512.title: In silico docking and in vivo assessment of Mondia whitei fruit extract in attenuating CdCl2-Induced neurodegeneration in rat
pmc-13068512.creator: Scholastica O. Anadozie, Olusola B. Adewale, Oluwole B. Akawa, Asueiza U. Aduma, Ikechukwu T. Ebe
pmc-13068512.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Cadmium is a toxic heavy metal found in the atmosphere. Its frequent exposure can lead to neurodegeneration. Medicinal plants are scavengers of free radicals that could result from exposure to heavy metals. In this study, the neuroprotective effect of the aqueous extract of Mondia whitei fruit (AEMW) against cadmium chloride (CdCl2)-induced neurotoxicity was investigated using an in silico and in vivo approach.

pmc-13159348.title: Improving primary healthcare for non-communicable diseases during annual flooding in Bihar, India: study protocol for a hybrid implementation-effectiveness parallel cluster randomised controlled trial
pmc-13159348.creator: Semira Manaseki-Holland, Tanvir Ahmed, Ratna Amrit, Steven Blackburn, Sunny Borgohain, Nupur Bose, Dorairaj Prabhakaran, Ashok Ghosh, Sheila Greenfield, Shasha Han, Linju Joseph, Rachel Jordan, Sue Jowett, Stefan Krause, Nishant Kumar, Suresh Munuswamy, Poornima Prabhakaran, Gavin Roudge, Benjamin R
pmc-13159348.description: BackgroundNon-communicable diseases (NCDs) cause 4.7 million deaths annually in India. Floods increasingly disrupt NCD care, especially in Bihar, one of India’s most flood-prone and socioeconomically disadvantaged states. This study aims to strengthen the capacity of the community and primary healthcare systems to improve NCD outcomes during annual flooding in Bihar.

pmc-13225975.title: Glycometabolic profiles and pregnancy outcomes across pathophysiological subtypes of gestational diabetes mellitus
pmc-13225975.creator: Junyou Su, Jing Luo, Xiaoting Huang, Yan Huang, Sumei Wang
pmc-13225975.description: BackgroundGestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) exhibits profound pathophysiological heterogeneity, but current management fails to account for subtype-specific differences in clinical features and pregnancy prognoses. This study aimed to characterize the glycometabolic profiles and pregnancy outcomes of GDM subtypes defined by insulin resistance and β-cell function, and provide a foundation for precision medicine in GDM.

pmc-13350716.title: Discovery of dynamic tumor microenvironment architecture with targeted agents in the multiplex implantable microdevice assay
pmc-13350716.creator: Juraj Jakubik, Zuzana Tatarova
pmc-13350716.description: s, the discovery of microanatomical domains often pertains to normal organs with inherent organization. Defining topological principles in tissues without strong structural patterning, such as cancer, has been limited, and deeper stratification in terms of identity and biological function, especially with treatment response, is challenging.

pmc-13556882.title: 342. Pharmacogenomics in alcohol use disorder: multi-omics meets brain organoids
pmc-13556882.creator: M-F Ho, C Zhang, H Li, R Weinshilboum
pmc-13556882.description: BackgroundWe previously conducted an open label acamprosate trial (n=442) in patients with alcohol use disorder (AUD). Acamprosate is an FDA-approved medication for the treatment of AUD, however, only about 50% of patients will respond to acamprosate. To date, no biological measures are utilized to predict response to acamprosate treatment.

pmc-13676984.title: Alternative splicing of a species- and skeletal muscle-specific microexon diversifies the menu of clathrin heavy chains in mice and rats
pmc-13676984.creator: R. Eric Blue, Adam J. Black, Jessica L. Cote, Sumaya A. Addish, Archishma Kavalipati, Scott P. Lyons, J. Ashley Ezzell, Steven C. Bremmer, Daniel Dominguez, Jimena Giudice
pmc-13676984.description: SummaryLittle is known about alternative splicing of microexons in most tissues other than the brain. Humans have two homologous clathrin heavy chains. Ubiquitously expressed, CLTC drives clathrin-mediated endocytosis. Highly expressed in skeletal muscles, CLTCL1 instead regulates glucose metabolism. Previously, we reported that a conserved microexon (exon 31) in the CLTC gene is alternatively spliced during striated muscle development.

uslaw-usc-t22-s10605.title: 22 U.S.C. § 10605 — Safeguards and accountability
uslaw-usc-t22-s10605.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t22-s10605.description: United States Code, Title 22 (Foreign Relations And Intercourse); Chapter 113 (United States Foundation For International Conservation). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Safeguards The Foundation shall develop, and incorporate into any agreement for support provided by the Foundation, appropriate safeguards, policies, and guidelines, consistent with United States law and best practices and standards for environmental and social safeguards. (b) Independent accountability.
